title: Osiris compiler configuration
description: Project-local compiler settings. Python package metadata and dependencies belong in pyproject.toml; build, watch, and run behavior is selected by osr commands.

$schema.description: JSON Schema location used by JSON-aware editors. It does not affect compilation.

source.description: Ordered project-relative Osiris source roots. A file path below a source root determines its dotted module name.

outDir.description: Project-relative destination for complete build artifacts, excluded from source discovery. "." generates beside the sources at the project root; artifacts are then written in place and only previously published artifacts are ever cleaned up.

exclude.description: Project-root-relative glob patterns shared by build, watch, check, format, LSC, module discovery, and LSP. A value without glob syntax excludes that path and all descendants.

targetPython.description: Python language version used for analysis and generated code. One build targets exactly one Python version; the minimum is 3.11.

strict.description: Treat unresolved dynamic boundaries, incomplete public contracts, and unsupported configuration as errors. It does not change reader syntax.

displayLocale.description: Default BCP 47 language tag for LSP labels and documentation. It never changes binding identity or generated code.
